levels.surface: بعجة بن عبد الله بن بدر

notes: the preface «وقد روي من، غير هذا الوجه عن عقبة بن عامر» is a second route for the same saying, with its transmitter marked only as another route; the unnamed link is that phrase
the main route «حدثنا بذلك محمد بن بشار» runs to Uqba; «بهذا الحديث» is not an isnad back reference and is left out
«قالا حدثنا هشام» makes Yazid and Abu Dawud co-transmitters from Hisham
